title: Airship: a design canvas layered over your dev server as a reverse proxy
description:
Airship puts a design canvas in front of the dev server you're already running, as a reverse proxy, so nothing enters your project, your bundle or your dependencies. Click an element, describe the change, and your existing coding agent edits the real source using the credentials it already has. Every frame is a live browser window, so desktop and phone update together from one file. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/0xnyn/airship
